summary: qBittorrent is a free, cross-platform BitTorrent client designed for peer-to-peer file sharing. It provides a comprehensive web user interface, allowing you to manage torrent downloads and uploads remotely from a browser. Written in C++, it operates as a standard desktop or daemon file transfer tool under the GPL-2.0 licence.
goodFor: It is well-suited for users who need a reliable, open-source peer-to-peer filesharing client that can be hosted on a headless server and controlled via a web interface.
watchOut: Exposing the web interface to the internet requires careful configuration of authentication and reverse proxy settings to prevent unauthorised access to your host system.
deployNotes: As a C++ application, it typically runs as a standalone daemon without needing a separate database, though you should configure persistent storage for your configuration files and download directories.
